name: Opensource UI
summary: Free MIT copy-paste React/Next widgets, forms, mockups, and backgrounds.

install.command: Open https://opensourceui.in/components/{slug}, copy source; npm install clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react

gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 200+ catalog components across 30 categories.
No shadcn registry / no Opensource UI npm package — copy-paste only.
Some components use next/image (App Router); peer apps need Next or a swap.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Tactile 3D Button
components.summary: Tactile 3D pressable button with depth variants.

demo.peerNotes: Copy-paste TypeScript + Tailwind. Needs @/lib/cn (clsx + tailwind-merge). Many comps use lucide-react; some use next/image.

copyPrompt.text: Use Opensource UI free MIT React/Next component `Tactile 3D Button` (slug `3d-button`, export `ThreeDButton`) from https://opensourceui.in/components/3d-button. Copy-paste the TypeScript source from the page (no Opensource UI npm package). Add `lib/cn.ts` and `npm install clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react` as listed on the component page. Catalog: https://opensourceui.in/components. Home: https://opensourceui.in. Repo: https://github.com/bidyut10/opensourceui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bidyut10/opensourceui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Bidyut Kundu). Pricing free.

installOverride.command: Open https://opensourceui.in/components/3d-button and copy the React + Tailwind TypeScript source
